name: The Sundarbans
summary: The world's largest mangrove forest and home of the Bengal tiger. Visits are by boat with a licensed operator and forest-guard escort.
season_note: November to February is the main tourist season with cool weather. The forest is closed to visitors for some months of the year.
avoid_note: Entry needs a permit through a licensed tour operator. Tiger sightings are rare. Check the forest department rules and current closures.

reach.how: AC coach from Dhaka (Gabtoli, Sayedabad) to Khulna, then road to Mongla
Fly to Jashore, then drive to Khulna/Mongla

local.group_fare: Operator package (3 days around 8000-18000 BDT per person)
local.note: Sleep on the boat; meals included in most packages.

attractions.name: Karamjal Wildlife Centre
attractions.what: A visitor centre with a deer park, crocodile breeding and forest walks.

attractions.name: Hiron Point (Nilkamal)
attractions.what: A remote forest spot known for tigers, deer and birds.
attractions.tip: Early morning forest walks are the highlight.

attractions.name: Katka Beach and Watchtower
attractions.what: A tower and a beach in the deep forest.

attractions.name: Dimer Char (Egg Island)
attractions.what: A sandy island with crabs and shore birds.
attractions.tip: Ask your guide about the tide.

attractions.name: Boat cruise between creeks
attractions.what: Slow cruising through creeks and mangroves is the main activity.
attractions.tip: Bring binoculars and be quiet for wildlife.

rules: Entry only with a permit and a licensed operator.
No littering or disturbing wildlife; keep quiet.
Do not wander outside the allowed paths.
